narrative.overview: A neighbourhood food guide for all ages: fresh white surfaces, near-black functional text, tomato actions and butter-yellow progression. Familiar Arial/Helvetica headings and reading, with Bricolage Grotesque reserved for the original wordmark. The approved interactive map remains the visual anchor.
rules: Desktop uses a horizontal masthead; Explore stays first and centred in phone navigation, with Feed prominent.
Fit the complete map in the available viewport; keep walking inline and optional details below the scene.
Passport places the owner wall and composer below a compact identity cover; additional game/profile detail expands on request.
Each page uses one natural document scroll with compact first sections. Longer feeds and collections continue below; do not freeze all content into one viewport.
Feed is story-led, trails pair photography with routes, and collections use open captions.
Demo activity stays separate from connected verified-account progression.
dos: Use tomato for decisive actions, yellow for XP, #111111 for functional reading and #414141 for secondary text.
Keep standalone header actions at least 44px, visible focus, labelled controls and reduced-motion fallbacks.
Use credited food photography and preserve the original illustrated map and avatar options.
donts: Do not present simulated visits or audience counts as verified.
Do not modify the original prototype.
Do not treat screenshots or contrast pairs as proof of production readiness or physical-device performance.
